A '''golden carrot''' is a [[carrot]] coated in gold nuggets. It heals {{Value|Golden Carrot|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Night Vision}} for {{Value|Golden Carrot|duration|effect=Night Vision}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/golden_carrot.json}}</ref> It is also a secret [[ingredient]] whose dishes grant Night Vision for longer than ordinary carrot dishes.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The recipe (8 gold nuggets around a carrot) is unlocked by picking up a gold nugget.

== Usage ==

=== Secret ingredient ===
{{Spoiler}}
Golden carrots make [[Steamed Golden Carrots|steamed golden carrots]] ({{Value|Steamed Golden Carrots|duration|effect=Night Vision|format=clock}}), [[Golden Pickled Carrots|golden pickled carrots]] ({{Value|Golden Pickled Carrots|duration|effect=Night Vision|format=clock}}) and the [[Golden Carrot Cupcake|golden carrot cupcake]] ({{Value|Golden Carrot Cupcake|duration|effect=Night Vision|format=clock}}). None of these recipes appear in the recipe book. See [[Secret recipes]].
